name: University of Limerick
feeMethod: Lists a separate non-EU fee for each programme, so the calculator uses each programme's own row.
description: The University of Limerick is a public university on a riverside campus outside Limerick city, founded in 1972 as the National Institute for Higher Education, Limerick and granted university status in 1989. It is known for its cooperative education programme, which places most undergraduates in paid work placements.
whyIncluded: One of the 10 universities in Ireland most popular with international students; Ireland is one of the nine places Singaporeans most often study abroad (about 270 Singaporean students, UNESCO data).

livingCosts.summary: The University of Limerick's 2025/26 cost-of-living sheet for international students: an on-campus room with utilities included, groceries, a monthly student bus ticket, phone, books and recreation. Residence permit, bedding and health insurance are one-off and left out.
livingCosts.notes: Rung A. UL 'Cost of Living 2025/26' (Global/International Education Division sheet, monthly figures). Housing = midpoint of 'On Campus Student Accommodation (including utilities)' EUR 700-1,100 = 900 (off-campus complexes 750-850 incl. utilities; private house share 600-1,000 plus utilities 100-150). Food = groceries 200-400 -> 300. Transport = Leap Card monthly student bus ticket 45. Personal = mobile 11-20 -> 15.50 + books/study materials/printing 75 + recreation 100-300 -> 200 = 290.50; gym (295/year) excluded because it is free for on-campus residents; laundry (7 a load) not budgeted. Months = 9 (Irish academic year; sheet gives monthly figures with no total). Excluded one-off: Irish Residence Permit 300, bedding/utensils 150-200, health insurance (variable), flights. UL's separate 'Budget Planner 2026/27' for incoming exchange students gives lower per-semester estimates (accommodation 2,600-3,900, food 1,000, clothes 300, books 200) but no transport line and no semester length, so it was not used.

History: 2025/26 EUR 18,000 ('Master of Science In Accounting' on postgraduate-fees-2025-2026, levy EUR 102 included). 2024/25: the programme started in September 2024 but UL's 2024-2025 PG fee page does not list it (only a Professional Diploma in Accounting), so no 2024 row. 2024 row (2026-10-16, official): UL's own MSc Accounting course page (course code MSIACCTFAD, September start), read in Common Crawl captures of 13 Apr 2024 and 6 Aug 2024, both before the September 2024 start, says 'EU - €9,750; Non-EU - €18,000'. The page carries no year label, but the captures predate the 2024 intake and the 2024-25 postgraduate fee schedule omits this MSc (it lists only the Professional Diploma in Accounting). Student levy not separated, as for the 2025 row (levy included in fee, compulsory 0).
